title: Bix Caleen
description: Bix Caleen was a scrapper on Ferrix. She connected her former lover, Cassian Andor, and Luthen Rael. Bix tried to help Cassian escape Preox-Morlana officers. Later, she was captured by Imperials. Doctor Gorst tortured Bix for information about Andor, but she resisted. Cassian rescued Caleen from her captors and sent her to Gangi Moon with B2EMO.
